title: Orsen and the Recipe
author: Wren Underhill
blurb: Isandro Thackeray, a coder whose anonymous account knows too much, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. Then the school's legendary ghost starts leaving notes addressed by name — in impossible ink — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must expose what the school board buried before prom.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
